object_owner.description: The role every object in this set is created as, reached by SET LOCAL ROLE and never by connecting (ADR 0026). Every control table forces row level security, so the definer functions it owns see only what the policies allow -- design G, ADR 0251.

auth_service.description: The identity service's role, which the control project's auth container connects as in APP_MODE=control. Readable only by a set whose project enables the control facility, and only in GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION app.<name>(...) and GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app (ADR 0251, D2046, D2073): it is given functions to execute and a schema to name them in, and no table.

migrations.name: control_identity
migrations.description: The control plane's people (ADR 0251, ADR 0252): the four organisation roles as an enum and a rank, accounts (a display copy of identity-registry users), organisations, memberships, invitations (account and membership, stored as the SHA-256 of a token shown once, at most 168 hours) and TOTP factors (a readable seed, ADR 0252's stated residual risk; last_step the replay guard). Every table in app with FORCE row level security and design G's policies: the caller from app.current_user_id(), an organisation scope set only after the caller's own membership was read, every scope reset on entry because a setting outlives its function (D2074). Definer functions granted to the identity service alone; control_totp_reset is invoker-rights and granted to nobody, for the operator.

migrations.name: control_keys
migrations.description: Management API keys (ADR 0253): apg_<key_id>_<secret>, the secret's SHA-256 stored, scopes bounded by a CHECK to Session 37's four read scopes, looked up with the owner's CURRENT role so a departed member's key finds none. control_remove_member lives here because it revokes the member's keys before deleting the membership; a key references its organisation and account, never the membership, so revoked keys remain as history (D2094).

migrations.name: control_registry
migrations.description: The project registry, adopted from deployed documents by root through control_adopt_project (invoker-rights, granted to nobody, D2068), and the operations table Session 38 fills -- no function inserts an operation, because no operation type is accepted while its Reality Ledger row is planned (ADR 0254, D2054). Members read their organisations' rows.

migrations.name: control_operations
migrations.description: Operations a member requests and the reconciler executes (Session 38; ADR 0256, ADR 0259): the operations table widened (claim, attempt, step, result, the one-time result secret) with two partial unique indexes -- one non-terminal operation per project, one non-terminal creation per organisation (D2166); the registry widened (display name, slot, region, profile, app route, deleted_at); app.control_slots, the reconciler's last reading of the host's slots (D2160); control_request_operation, control_cancel_operation, control_take_result_secret, control_ready_slot_count and control_project_operations granted to the identity service; the reconciler's claim, advance, finish, interrupted, record_slots and mark_deleted, and control_adopt_project re-created wider, SECURITY INVOKER and granted to nobody (D2093); the key vocabulary gains projects:write (D2165).

migrations.name: control_endpoints
migrations.description: A project's public endpoints in the registry and the customer's credential rotation (Session 39; ADR 0268, ADR 0269, ADR 0270): control_projects.endpoints, the deployed document's database.public, written by control_adopt_project (re-created wider, invoker-rights, granted to nobody) and read by a viewer and above through control_project_endpoints (definer, granted to the identity service); control_request_operation accepts credential.rotate (member and above), whose arguments carry a SCRAM verifier and never a password; control_result_members lets credential.rotate record its role and project.resize its admission reading (D2362).

migrations.name: control_branches
migrations.description: Branches and the backups surface (Session 40; ADR 0271, ADR 0272, ADR 0273): control_branches (what the reconciler last read of each branch.json, written whole by control_record_branches, granted to nobody) and control_backup_readings (one reading per project with its age, control_record_backups, granted to nobody); the definer readers control_list_branches, control_get_branch and control_get_backups resolve the project first, so a foreign and a missing branch are one not_found (D2451); control_request_operation replaced with the same signature -- the four branch types, one live branch per project refused AP409 branch_limit_reached before any row (D2430), a reset or deletion names a recorded live branch, a project with a live branch is not deleted (D2438), the expiry's 15-minute to 7-day bounds; control_operations.origin (member | expiry) and control_request_expiry, granted to nobody, which requests one branch.delete on behalf of the member who set the expiry (ADR 0272).

migrations.name: control_operation_origin
migrations.description: An operation read names its origin (Session 40; ADR 0272, D2480): control_list_operations and control_get_operation, dropped and re-created wider by control_operations.origin (0006) -- member, or expiry for the one branch.delete control_request_expiry writes -- and granted to the identity service again, so a customer reads through /v1 whether a branch's deletion was its expiry's or a member's.

migrations.name: control_plans_usage
migrations.description: Plans, usage, notifications and idle sleep (Session 41; ADR 0274, ADR 0275, ADR 0276): control_organizations.plan and control_plan_limits, the SQL twin of services/auth-api/app/plans.py; control_request_operation replaced with the same signature -- projects_active and branches_total checked under the organisation's row lock, reachable through a lock-only UPDATE policy because a definer's FOR UPDATE under FORCE row security locked nothing without one (rig 41d, D2538), AP409 plan_limit_reached / branch_limit_reached before any row; control_plan_interest (Notify me, one row per organisation and plan); control_usage_samples, written by control_record_usage (granted to nobody) and read through control_usage_document by control_project_usage and control_org_usage; control_notifications, written in control_finish_operation's own transaction from a fixed template (0004's body plus one marked block) and by control_record_limit_notice (granted to nobody, one a day); control_projects.idle_sleep_minutes set by control_set_idle_sleep, and control_request_idle_sleep (granted to nobody) inserting one project.sleep with origin idle over a full quiet window -- no customer backend is quiet, an unread sample is not (D2539); the origin CHECK widened; control_branches.reason and door, recorded by control_record_branches and served by control_list_branches and control_get_branch, dropped and created again wider.

migrations.name: control_insights
migrations.description: Query Insights, DB time and monitoring (Session 42; ADR 0278, ADR 0279): control_insight_samples, written by control_record_insights (granted to nobody; the top 50 statements of the customer-facing roles AS READ, the text cut to 2000, older than 7 days deleted by the writer) and read through control_project_insights -- increases with resets read, never a finding or a confidence, fewer than two samples could_not_determine; control_usage_samples.db_time_ms and statements_reset, control_record_usage re-created with the two keys (0008's body plus them), the unread CHECK widened, control_usage_document re-created with DB time (0008's body plus one marked block); control_project_monitoring reading only the usage samples, the backups reading and the insight samples.
